title: Unit economics + hiring flow sensitivity (Q3 2026)
summary: A compact model connecting pricing changes, token usage growth, and phased hiring to net burn and runway. Includes three base scenarios and sensitivity tables for +/-10/20% price moves and hiring lag adjustments.
content:
Purpose:
- Provide leadership a quick decision tool: how do price changes and hiring cadence affect monthly burn and runway for Q3–Q6 2026?
- Input to sales/finance pricing deliberation and People Ops hiring freeze assessment.

Key assumptions (baseline):
- Starting ARR (MRR extrapolated): $48M ARR at 2026-03-01.
- Monthly active customers growth: baseline +3% month-over-month, conservative +1%, aggressive +6%.
- Average revenue per 1k tokens: baseline $0.40, conservative $0.36 (-10%), aggressive $0.44 (+10%).
- Variable cost per 1k tokens (inference infra + networking + cache ops): $0.10 baseline.
- Fixed G&A and R&D opex (excludes hiring) monthly run-rate: $2.6M.
- Average fully-burdened IC cost: engineering $22k/mo, infra $24k/mo, product $18k/mo, sales/CS $16k/mo.
- Hiring plan (baseline): net +18 heads across Q3 (6/mo), phased hires start billing 40%/70%/100% across months they join (ramp).

Scenarios (Q3 start -> Q6 end window used to project four months):
1) Baseline: growth +3% MoM, price $0.40/1k, hires as planned (18 total).
2) Conservative: growth +1% MoM, price -10% ($0.36), hiring slowed by 50% (9 hires).
3) Aggressive: growth +6% MoM, price +10% ($0.44), accelerated hiring +50% (27 hires).

Top-line sensitivity table (illustrative):
- Inputs vary: price +/-10% and +/-20%; growth +/-2% absolute; hiring lag +/-1 month.

Simple monthly extract (numbers rounded):
Table: Monthly P&L by scenario (columns: Month, Revenue, Variable Cost, Gross Margin, Fixed Opex, Hiring Cost, Net Burn)

M2: Revenue $4,120,000 | VarCost $1,030,000 | Gross $3,090,000 | Fixed $2,600,000 | Hiring $396,000 | Net Burn $- (burn) $- (net) $94,000
M3: Revenue $4,243,600 | VarCost $1,061,000 | Gross $3,182,600 | Fixed $2,600,000 | Hiring $594,000 | Net Burn $- $-5,400
M4: Revenue $4,370,900 | VarCost $1,093,000 | Gross $3,277,900 | Fixed $2,600,000 | Hiring $594,000 | Net Burn -$ (net cash) $83,900

M4: Rev $4,010,000 | Var $1,002,500 | Gross $3,007,500 | Fixed $2,600,000 | Hiring $297,000 | Net Burn $- (burn) $ - (gap) $-

M4: Rev $4,920,000 | Var $1,230,000 | Gross $3,690,000 | Fixed $2,600,000 | Hiring $891,000 | Net Burn $199,000 (net positive)

Headcount plan (baseline detailed by function):
- Engineering (serving/runtime + infra): +8 hires over Q3 (2 backend infra, 3 model-serving, 3 SRE); cost impact months M1–M4: $176k, $352k, $528k, $528k.
- Product & Design: +3 hires; monthly ramped cost: $54k, $108k, $162k, $162k.
- Sales & CS: +5 hires (quota-bearing ramping); monthly cost: $80k, $160k, $240k, $240k.
- Finance/People/Legal: +2 hires; monthly cost: $60k, $120k, $180k, $180k.

Pricing sensitivity (short matrix):
- Price -20% (to $0.32): monthly revenue delta vs baseline ~ -$800k M1 growing with usage; runway shortens by ~ 2.1 months on present cash assumptions.
- Price -10% (to $0.36): revenue delta ~ -$400k M1; runway shortens by ~1.0 month.
- Price +10% (to $0.44): revenue delta ~ +$400k M1; runway extends by ~ 0.9 months.
- Price +20% (to $0.48): revenue delta ~ +$800k M1; runway extends by ~2.0 months.

Hiring cadence sensitivity:
- 1-month hiring delay (all hires pushed one month): reduces near-term burn but increases backfill/product velocity risk; runway improves by ~0.6 months but model risk increases.
- Hiring 50% faster (front-loaded): immediate burn increases ~30% in first two months versus baseline, but revenue capture (sales ramp) may improve in M3–M4 in aggressive growth scenarios.

Conclusions and recommended actions (for exec review):
1) Near-term pricing cuts materially shorten runway vs small price increases materially extend runway. Pricing changes should be coordinated with Sales (churn risk) and Product (value metrics).
2) If macro weakens (growth slips to +1% MoM), implement a temporary hiring pause for non-critical infra and product roles (delay 6–8 hires) to preserve >= 12 months runway.
3) If demand proves sticky and growth accelerates to +6% MoM, prioritize front-loading sales & CS hires to capture expansion; fund by selective deferral of non-essential R&D projects.
4) Implement a 2-week cadence to re-run this sheet with real consumption data and a 1:1 mapping of major accounts > $250k ARR to capture concentration risk.

Open questions / notes to reviewers:
- Confirm token-unit accounting change slated for billing pipeline in May (affects effective price per 1k).
- Validate fully-burdened hire rates with People Ops (we used coarse bands).
- Agree a guardrail: if runway < 10 months, trigger hiring freeze + price review.

Action items:
- Finance: finalize headcount cashflow by 2026-03-15 for Monday exec package (owner: Aisha).
- Sales: provide list of 20 expansion-target accounts and timing risk (owner: Marcus).
- People Ops: confirm expected offer acceptance timing and earliest start dates (owner: Rina).

Notes (rough scratch):
- This sheet intentionally prioritized clarity / quick sensitivity over granular seat-level payroll amortization.
- Follow-up model will add per-account price elasticity and churn assumptions.

End of document.
